name: Hobin
source:
The manager of Café Banjul. It's rumoured that due to his personal preferences, a lot of good looking guys work at the café.

He likes animals and hates troublesome things. He's currently trying to quit smoking.

Likes: Cats
Dislikes: Whoever tries to wake him up when he's sleeping

[From [url=http://nl.cheritz.com/en/game_info/characters]Nameless Official Site[/url]]
